adminVolunteers.title: Volunteer applications
adminVolunteers.lead: Everyone who applies to volunteer, oldest first. Approving gives the person the volunteer role, so check them as you would anyone who will work near children.

detail.name: Name
detail.noEmail: No email address: they sign in by phone
detail.guardianWaiting: Under 18: waiting for their guardian to approve

standing.outdated: Accepted an older version: they must accept the current one

done.approved: Approved. {name} now holds the volunteer role, and we have told them.

approve.title: Approve
approve.body: Approving gives {name} the volunteer role and records the declarations they accepted. You will be asked for your second factor again if you last gave it more than 10 minutes ago.
approve.forbidden: Your role doesn't allow you to approve volunteers.

refused.invalid_transition: This application is not waiting for a community manager.
refused.unpublished: A declaration has no published version, so nothing can be approved yet.
refused.safeguarding_missing: The applicant hasn't made the safeguarding declaration.
refused.safeguarding_outdated: The applicant accepted an older safeguarding declaration. They must accept the current version first.
refused.conduct_missing: The applicant hasn't accepted the code of conduct.
refused.conduct_outdated: The applicant accepted an older code of conduct. They must accept the current version first.

decline.title: Decline
decline.hint: The applicant, or a teen's guardian, is told this. Be kind and clear. Up to {max} characters.
decline.forbidden: Your role doesn't allow you to decline volunteers.

refused.invalid_input: Enter a reason of up to 500 characters.
